Carnide — Lisbon, Portugal

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Carnide's Bairro Padre Cruz is a recurring, well-documented drug-dealing and violence hotspot: PSP recorded 21 arrests there in a single month (2023), and separate shooting incidents left four people wounded in 2020 and two more in 2022, both widely covered by Publico, Observador, DN and JN. A group also attacked the local police station and threatened further violence (Correio da Manhã), and PSP has run repeated raids there targeting jewellery-store robbery suspects. Given the frequency and severity of drug-trafficking operations and armed incidents, both day and night carry serious documented risk in this specific bairro, though other parts of the freguesia are not similarly flagged. Sources checked: Observador, 19 Apr 2023 – "PSP deteve 21 pessoas no último mês no bairro lisboeta Padre Cruz"; Publico, 22 Aug 2022 – "Lisboa. Tiroteio junto ao Bairro Padre Cruz faz dois feridos"; DN/Publico/Observador/JN/Renascença, 6 Aug 2020 – "Quatro baleados em desordem no Bairro Padre Cruz"; Correio da Manhã – "Grupo ataca esquadra do Bairro Padre Cruz e ameaça repetir violência"; Correio da Manhã – "Quatro detidos em operação da PSP no Bairro Padre Cruz, suspeitos de assaltos a ourivesarias".
